title: file-archive executor
description: Archive a folder, or a target's declared build output, into a zip or tar written next to it.

source.description: Folder to archive, relative to the workspace root. Takes precedence over buildTarget. Defaults to the single output the build target declares.

buildTarget.description: Target whose declared output is archived when source is not set. Ignored when source is set. Defaults to build.

destination.description: Folder the archive is written into, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to the folder that contains source.

filename.description: Archive filename, written under destination. Defaults to <basename(source)>.<format>.
